summary: `CatalogGenerationStore` (generation/pointer-based atomic catalog installer) has no call sites; the app's only actual catalog-load path (`DataStore.ensureCatalog()`) uses a different, simpler digest-check-plus-Room-transaction mechanism.
claim: `CatalogGenerationStore` (generation/pointer-based atomic catalog installer) has no call sites; the app's only actual catalog-load path (`DataStore.ensureCatalog()`) uses a different, simpler digest-check-plus-Room-transaction mechanism.

evidence.source: core/CatalogGenerationStore.kt defines `install()`/`active()` with atomic file moves and a pointer file; data/Databases.kt's `DataStore.ensureCatalog()` never references `CatalogGenerationStore`, instead reading `ofd-catalog.tsv.gzip` directly from assets and replacing rows inside a Room `withTransaction`.

suggested_remediation: Either integrate `CatalogGenerationStore` for its intended purpose or remove it to avoid ambiguity about which replacement mechanism is authoritative.
suggested_validation: Grep/build-time check confirming zero non-test references, or an end-to-end test if it is retained and wired in.
reviewer_confidence: HIGH (presence/absence of call sites is directly verifiable in the fully supplied source).
